tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows a damped fast transient, but the inputs are strongly correlated and the observations cover only a narrow horizon range. A trajectory batch can distinguish transient dynamics from an approximately instantaneous equilibrium before fitting a forecast model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a damped single-state or quasi-equilibrium model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five correlated pilot rows at similar horizons cannot distinguish these mechanisms or reliably identify transient parameters.
The auxiliary measurement is irrelevant to identifying the temporal law.
